Cancel an in-progress response

```python title="Python"

import os
from liter_llm import create_client

async def main() -> None:
    client = create_client(api_key=os.environ["API_KEY"])
    response_id = "resp-def456"
    result = await client.cancel_response(response_id)
    print(result.id)
    print(result.status)
    print(result.output)

asyncio.run(main())
```
